style.look: High-end 2D fantasy RPG battle visual effect for a HD-2D pixel-art game: hand-painted, crisp, clean bold shapes with fine painterly detail, luminous glow, vivid saturated colours, strong value contrast, dynamic anime-style energy shapes, readable silhouette at small size.
style.mono: Render the whole effect in monochrome only: pure white hot core fading through light grey to dark grey at the edges, absolutely no hue, no colour tint, so it can be recoloured later.
style.black: Background: perfectly flat pure black (#000000) everywhere, no gradient, no texture, no vignette, no stars, no ground, no floor, no reflections.
style.clear: Background: fully transparent; the effect has clean edges and no ground plane, no cast shadow, no backdrop.
style.neg: No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no frame outlines, no panels, no characters, no creatures, no weapons, no hands, no UI.
style.key: Background: perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, one uniform colour, no gradient, no shadow, no ground plane; the effect itself contains no magenta, pink or purple.

A silver ink quill strike animation: several swift bold calligraphy brush strokes of luminous silver-white ink with deep blue shadows slash across from upper right to lower left, ink droplets spraying. Frame 1 the first stroke, frames 2-4 the strokes crossing in a fierce pattern, frames 5-6 the ink fading into glowing droplets.

An erasure wave animation: a vast flat wave of blank white light with torn paper-like edges sweeps outward, erasing everything, faint grey ink flecks and dissolving lines flaking away at its rim. Frame 1 a white point, frames 2-5 the white blank wave expanding into a wide glowing disc with paper-edge rim, frames 6-8 the whiteness fading leaving flecks.

A blank page storm animation: a violent whirlwind of perfectly blank white pages and pale silver light streaks, the pages sharp and glowing at the edges, swirling in a wide spiral with white sparkles. Frames 1-2 forming, frames 3-6 a raging white page whirlwind, frames 7-8 pages scattering into light.

A whiteout implosion and burst animation: soft pale lavender-white light gathers into a sphere of pure blinding whiteness, then bursts outward into a huge soft glowing white dome with faint silver ripples, dissolving everything into light. Frame 1 a faint glow, frames 2-3 gathering, frames 4-6 the blinding white dome, frames 7-8 fading haze.

An oblivion ripple wave animation, seen at a slight top-down angle: concentric rings of pale silver and lavender light ripple outward like a wave on still water, dissolving tiny glowing fragments that drift up. Frames 1-2 the first ring, frames 3-6 several rings spreading wide, frames 7-8 fading.

A single ring of eight glowing elemental orbs arranged evenly in a circle: a red fire orb, a blue water orb, a green wind orb, a brown-amber earth orb, a golden light orb, a violet dark orb, a white star orb and a silver moon orb, linked by a thin luminous golden circle with fine ornate engravings, flat top-down view.

A colossal glowing book closing animation: two enormous radiant pages of golden-white light, with faint lines of glowing script-like patterns (not readable letters), swing in from the left and right and slam shut together in the centre with a blinding flash and a burst of paper light motes. Frames 1-2 two pages opening wide, frames 3-4 the pages closing, frame 5 the shut flash, frames 6-8 light motes scattering.

An unwriting void slash animation: a huge diagonal tear of pitch-black void with glowing iridescent prismatic edges rips across from upper right to lower left, faint pale fragments of glowing script patterns peel away and dissolve into it. Frame 1 a thin rift, frames 2-4 the void tear opening wide, frames 5-7 fragments being sucked in, frame 8 the rift sealing.

A dream oblivion breath stream animation: a flowing stream of soft prismatic pastel light, pale rose, lavender and aqua, with sleepy glittering motes and fading memory-like glimmers, flowing from the right edge of each wide cell to the left, narrow at the right and spreading into a dreamy cloud at the left. Frames 1-2 starting, frames 3-6 the full stream, frames 7-8 fading.

A single enormous ornate magic circle of the end of a story: intricate concentric rings of gold and iridescent rainbow light, an open-book motif at the centre, eight small elemental emblems around the rim, fine geometric lines and stars, perfectly round, flat top-down view.

A wave of despair animation: a dark shockwave of black and deep crimson energy spreads outward with ghostly screaming-shaped smoke wisps (no faces), crimson embers and dark lightning crackles. Frame 1 a dark pulse, frames 2-5 the black-crimson wave expanding, frames 6-8 dissipating into crimson embers.

A demonic flame pillar animation: a tall column of crimson and black hellfire rising from the bottom of each cell, with a dark core, bright red-orange edges and black smoke, swirling crimson embers. Frame 1 flames igniting, frames 2-4 a raging black-crimson fire pillar, frames 5-6 the flames collapsing into embers.

A demon shadow claw rake animation: four huge curved claw slashes of black shadow with burning crimson edges tear diagonally from upper right to lower left, trailing dark smoke and red sparks. Frame 1 tips appearing, frames 2-3 the claws ripping through, frames 4-6 the gashes smouldering away.

A cosmic ouroboros ring finale animation: a huge glowing circle made of overlapping golden-green dragon scales and emerald light, shaped like a ring with a tapering end biting into itself, contracts tight and then bursts outward in a brilliant golden-emerald explosion of scales and light. Frames 1-3 the scale ring glowing and contracting, frame 4 the burst, frames 5-8 scales and light scattering.

A time rewind animation: concentric rings of glowing teal and gold light with tick marks like a clock face (no numbers) spin rapidly in reverse, with afterimage streaks and floating shards of broken time light. Each frame rotated further backwards; seamless loop.

A dragon scale storm animation: a fierce whirlwind of sharp iridescent emerald, gold and teal dragon scales spinning like blades, with glinting light flashes. Frames 1-2 scales lifting, frames 3-6 a dense slicing scale whirlwind, frames 7-8 scales scattering.

An eternal breath stream animation: a spiralling stream of deep teal, emerald and gold cosmic energy with twisting infinite-loop shaped swirls and star glints, flowing from the right edge of each wide cell to the left, narrow at the right and blooming wide at the left. Frames 1-2 starting, frames 3-6 the full spiralling stream, frames 7-8 fading.
